notes.title: Trick or Treating in Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]Version Update 1.2.0[/b][/u]

[b]Patch Highlights[/b]
•	New Adventure Map: Qian Shou returns for the ultimate challenge in an adventure through the Otherworld.
•	New Boss Encounter: X’athky the Spider Priestess will appear randomly as a boss encounter in various maps across Corum.
•	New Cards: Over 20 new full art cards will be unlocked automatically after the update!
•	New Skins: Seven new skins and an alternate art celebrating the champion of the grand tournament will be available in the store.
•	Matchmaking Update: New matchmaking settings for Dueling Mode.
•	Clan Feature: Clans are now open to all players.
•	Battle Stage Customization: Players can now freely customize battle stages.
•	Card Balances: Adjustments made to Card Cache cards.
•	Bug Fixes: Various improvements and text enhancements.
________________________________________

[b]New Adventure Map – The Otherworld[/b]

Qian Shou returns to Corum to issue her final challenge. Face the Living Legend in The Otherworld, where every card you draft matters and every choice you make creates a unique deck for the fight of your life. This pocket dimension houses the most challenging opponents, equipped with X cards and game-changing mutators that will push you to make bold plays and unique combos for victory. Don’t fear, as a mysterious energy in The Otherworld will grant you extraordinary power and enhance the drops you receive as you traverse its lands. Unveil the mysteries as you delve deep into the abyss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/6709ca71a82849e342738acf7d8dd1fb5cb0f998.png[/img]
________________________________________

[b]New Adventure Boss – X’athky the Spider Priestess[/b]

Escape the webs of destiny spun by the Spider Priestess from the northern tribes, where she has woven her domain of arachnids throughout the caverns of death. Her army's tunnels connect different continents across Corum, allowing her passage wherever she desires. Starting this update, X’athky will appear randomly as a boss encounter in Adventure Maps. Be cautious—her deadly legs can pierce the very soul from your body!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/1c9782eb4a411d932dcdc977d3e62fa78c98cda5.jpg[/img]
________________________________________

[b]A Gift from Us – 23 Full Art Cards Available Now![/b]

After the update, all players will have access to 23 full art cards across all 11 champions in the game. Enhance your deck with stunning artwork and enjoy your combos even more with a hand full of delight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/5bb95be29a941602f8aaf2469e9d70d33873a9b0.jpg[/img]
________________________________________

[b]New Seasonal Collections Ready in the Shop[/b]
With the holiday season approaching, the shop is stocked with new skins and alternate art:

•	Roxxor – Van Gogh: Paint, splash, create! Don't judge a book by its cover. The robust giant of the forests may have large hands and cumbersome movements, but his dexterity rivals that of the masters. Showcase your combos with Roxxor in his new Van Gogh outfit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/feae33b5f9e0c9cd9211df2ebde5af7addde2529.png[/img]

•	Sora – S Pop: Shoot for the stars and aim for the galaxy! Sora dazzles with her spells and wands, while her voice melts hearts with every beat. Take the stage with Sora, the upcoming top idol!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/c7b46ccc275559361bfd3f0c376e219b57445174.png[/img]

•	Taj – Undertaker: The cycle of life and death mirrors a journey through the Nile—quiet, peaceful, and solemn. Join Taj on his path of redemption as the undertaker of life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/aa73c394b5cb6569fb52c64b645d5c2f348c8912.png[/img]

•	Enryu – Nidhogg: Be reborn as nature’s judgment against mankind in the spirit of destruction. Rise 
from the flames to abolish greed and restore Mother Nature to its perfection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/b768cdd252dff23504e5b8b813af697baccc3d1c.png[/img]

•	Lee and Redeye – Deathmatch: Capture the essence of Death or Glory in stunning artwork as Lee and Redeye face off in a climactic battle. Collect the dynamic duo in an alternate ink style to complete your collection!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/4f64fba515676c2950421f9a2f284c9a16551078.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/9a6707fdedebd17f2edfdd60c77f4ddce57d620b.png[/img]

•	Susan – Artemis: Congratulations to Outer Heaven, the winning clan from last month’s Clan Wars event. Victory shines upon you, and the heavens praise your glory. Susan, embodying the spirit of Artemis, will join your celebration as the top clan of the Arena! Every member of Outer Heaven will receive this skin for free after the update!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/2007a4c4559c535e030fc10422a894863a5aa39f.png[/img]
________________________________________
[u][b]Alternate Art – Force Multiplier (A.T.A.C.R)[/b][/u]

Congratulations to Majstor, the top Champion of the world! After numerous hard-fought battles, we celebrate all players who joined the Grand Tournament with an alternate art card of Force Multiplier, the trophy card our champion has chosen. All contenders will receive a code through Discord to unlock this special prize in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/760405af24613accaa4eef656d8bf6068d529b12.png[/img]
________________________________________
[u][b]New Matchmaking Settings[/b][/u]

New matchmaking options are now available in the options menu, allowing players to control the type of queue they wish to enter for PVP. These settings will override existing conditions and matchmaking rules.
________________________________________
[u][b]Clans Feature

[/b][/u]Clans are back! After this update, all players can create their own clans and gather members into their team. Players can also leave their current clan and join another one if they choose. All controls will remain accessible within the clan leaderboard tab from the top bar.
________________________________________
[u][b]Battle Stage Customization[/b][/u]

A new feature allows players to customize the appearance of the battle stage during combat. Over 10 backgrounds from across the game have been added to the library of selectable battle stages, including some new ones as a special treat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/9c40add9fbae425372bfbaa6a59915877e2352d9.png[/img]
________________________________________
[u][b]Card Balancing[/b][/u]

[b]Lee – Like the Wind and Like the Wind X[/b]
[i]The “Like the Wind” mechanic enhances Lee’s flexibility for combos, providing both resources and driver options. However, these benefits weren't always worth the slot in the deck compared to other cards. To make this card more special and enable its use, the action point cost has been removed:[/i]
•	Action Point Cost: 1 > 0

[b]Taj – Ethereal Projection and Ethereal Projection X[/b]
[i]This powerful card in Taj’s kit gains the most benefits when running a 3-worship deck, translating into significant damage. To balance this, we are reducing the base attack damage by 1:[/i]
•	Attack Damage: 7 > 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/f813c3a12f708c799142c10465d60cf8b35e503c.jpg[/img]
________________________________________
[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
•	Fixed a bug that caused perpetual attacks not to discard a card when reacting to a missile at speed 3.
•	Fixed a bug with fast reactions leading to an overflowed discard pile when dazed.
•	Fixed various typos and wording inconsistencies in the card cache.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.8 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Ver 1.0.7 [/b]

[u][b]Patch Highlights [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Roxxor Upgrade Cards Balancing
[*] Bug fixes and Performance Improvements
[/list]

[u][b]Character Balancing[/b][/u]

[b]Roxxor the Giant[/b] 
[i]Roxxor falls behind other champions in his diversity of playstyles with a narrow range of playable upgraded cards. As one of the earlier characters which we designed upgraded cards for, we admittedly started off rather conservatively with the power levels of his cards that can change up the pacing of his strategies. [/i]

[u]Spine Pull X [/u]
[i]This grapple was designed as the fastest but weakest one out of Roxxor’s kit. But as an upgraded card with a high rate of failure, it doesn’t make the cut unless it has more of a set up potential to boost other cards. The added Momentum can make Roxxor’s playstyle faster as it is only for a single action point opening up a more aggressive rate of play. [/i]

Momentum Value : 1 < 2 

[u]Monster Pummel X [/u]
[i]This is a small but rather important stat buff as usually champions will have access to blocks with a value of 7. This buff makes Monster pummel essentially a 50% health check where as long as his set up cards has chipped away half or he plays pummel twice, it will be a sure kill. [/i]

Attack Damage : 26 < 27 

[u]Head Twist X [/u]
[i]Momentum is decreased to make the card more playable earlier into the game as choke is a damage mechanic that is stronger the faster it is played. [/i]

Momentum Cost : 4 > 3 

[u]Trunk Whack and Trunk Whack X[/u] 
[i]Trunk Whack is an interesting reaction card where it is not designed as your typical answer to your opponents, but instead it is a punishment for forgetting that it exists. The nature of Trunk Whack is to be a sabotaging card where the damage it can deal could potentially be game winning with one big strike. This attribute was probably too hidden with a rather generic damage value so we increased the damage and replaced determined in the upgrade version with a damage boost that can further this mechanic to bigger extremes. [/i]

[u]Trunk Whack [/u]
Damage Value : 5 < 8

[u]Trunk Whack X[/u]
Action Point Cost : 1 < 2
Damage Value : 5 < 8 
Removed Card Text : You are granted Determined
New Card Text : The damage of your next attack this turn is increased by 8. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/f5e25a20106247de0414a827fa7bd2e9b595376c.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Vampyric Familiar where Blood Feast is consumed regardless if the condition is met 
[*] Fixed a bug concerning Crow Ascendancy where crows no longer are created after an alpha crow 
[*] Improved memory flushing logic to improve performance when switching rooms and game modes in game
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 1.0.6 Patch
notes.notes:
[u][b]Version 1.0.6 
Patch Highlights [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Redeye and Ardelean balancing 
[*] Lifesteal and Fortune Reversal Clarification and Mechanic Updates 
[*] Various Bug Fixes and changes 
[/list]

[u][b]Character Balancing [/b][/u]
[b]Redeye the Werewolf[/b]
[i]Redeye has been at the top end of the meta for a long time now and the proprietor of the aggressive pacing that the meta needs to answer in order to stay competitive. Redeye by design is a boom or bust character where he either wins quickly or struggles to recover from bad turns. We’re toning down Howl to limit the amount of damage that can be dished out in a turn and making it easier for the opponent to regain control through reactions to stop the rampaging werewolf.[/i]

[u]Howl [/u]
Bloodlust requirement : 1 > 0 
Damage boost value : 2 > 1 
[u]Howl X [/u]
Bloodlust requirement : 1 > 0  

[b]Ardelean the Vampire[/b]
[i]We are making several more changes to Ardelean in this balance patch to limit the amount of flexibility his deck has access to. From consistent draws to powerful blood feast effects, the combination creates a very stable experience with the vampire where as long as he gets his resources going, he quickly snowballs to become unstoppable in both offensive and defensive aspects. We are targeting these 3 cards to limit the snowball effect on good turns when he has all the pieces at once. [/i]

[u]Ulterior Motive and Ulterior Motive X [/u]
Bonus Speed Value : 2 > 1 
[u]Primal Thirst and Primal Thirst X [/u]
Bonus Attack Value : 3 > 2 
[u]Death Awakening [/u]
Blood Feast requirement : 4 < 5 
[u]Death Awakening X [/u]
Bonus Cards Drawn : 4 > 3 

[u]Nocturnal Hunter X [/u]
[i]We are changing the effect of this card because of the changes to LifeSteal and Fortune Reversal not being affected by the bonuses and limitations of Healing effects. As Ardelean already has many survival options, we opted to change the effect to an offensive tool to help Ardelean land attacks and blood feast generators more reliably. [/i]

Card Text Removed : You are granted Double Heal 
Added Card Text : The damage of your next attack is increased by 3. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/d9d77505954294171d41dbddf0303c53711686a9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/cb2f60c8af64850a4627b9dea7cc61215c78e1a4.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Lifesteal and Fortune Reversal clarifications[/b][/u]
[i]We have updated the keyword text of these two mechanics to clear up confusions and change their interactions with Heal enhancers and limiters. These two mechanics will not be affected by bonus heal effects moving forward nor will they be affected by mechanics that will prohibit them as they are considered a Steal and Recovery. We will be designing and balancing cards under this philosophy moving forward when Ardelean and other champions receive changes. [/i]

Life Steal : At the end of turn, take X lives from your opponent 
Fortune Reversal : You will temporarily lose 5(X) lives to draw X cards. For X turns, you will recover 5 lives at the end of turn. 

[b]Bug Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that causes the splash art in the character selection screen to not reflect the selected skin 
[*] Fixed a bug that causes the game to crash when perpetual is blocked
[*] Fixed a bug that disables the flashing function when a missile is intercepted with an attack with daze
[*] Fixed a bug that causes the discard pile to shuffle incorrectly and become stuck at the top of the screen
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]Version 1.0.4 Patch Highlights [/b][/u]
•	Character balancing
•	Bug fixes and gameplay optimisation
[u][b]
Character Balancing [/b][/u]

[b]Ardelean the Vampire [/b]
[i]The launch of the dark lord has been an amazing one. Learning from our previous mistakes, we’ve carefully designed the interactions of Blood Feast and Blood Rush to create a new Monster experience. Due to the mechanic, Ardelean is atypical in his playstyle where he has to first collect blood then choose what abilities to upgrade with strategic card ordering. With a high ceiling and potential, we felt we had made certain elements of his set up a bit too easy. The following changes will lower the floor of Ardelean to balance out his potential compared to other champions.[/i] 

[b]Vampiric Familiar and Vampyric Familiar X [/b]
[i]Unleashed cards are non-interactable for the opponent and generally balanced as a turn-by-turn win condition where the benefits don’t typically spread to subsequent turns. However, the almost inevitable lifesteal this card applies for just 2 blood feast, essentially sets up Ardelean for the whole game. We are adding in an additional condition for lifesteal to activate to require Ardelean to make more daring and bold plays to set up. [/i]

[u]Vampyric Familiars [/u]
New card text : If you have already dealt damage this turn and you have Blood Feast, consume it and you are granted Lifesteal(1) and Cure. 
[u]Vampyric Familiars X [/u]
New card text : If you have already dealt damage this turn and you have Blood Feast, consume it and you Heal 5 lives, granted Lifesteal(1) and Cure. 

[u]Ulterior Motive X[/u]
[i]Similarly, we felt that a powerful mechanic such as lifesteal should be conditional and require timing to play out. [/i]

New card text : If neither you nor your opponent has any cards in play, attack speed is increased by 2 and you are granted Lifesteal(1). 

[u]Breathless Embrace and Breathless Embrace X[/u]
[i]We’re tuning down the damage of this card to make it easier to stop and reducing the base amount of blood feast that can be gained.[/i]

Attack damage : 7 > 6 

[u]Crimson Mist [/u]
[i]Dodge is the best type of reaction in game and normally its speed value is the major inhibiting factor of it. We’re removing the second tier of speed buff to limit its effectiveness and all rounded capabilities. [/i]

Removed card text : If you have Blood Feast(3), consume it and your reaction speed is increased by 2 instead. 

[b]Tori the Paladin [/b]
[i]Some small changes across cards to balance out the card choice in decks.[/i]

[u]Invocation and Invocation X [/u]
Attack damage : 10 > 9
 
[u]Judgement and Judgement X[/u] 
Attack damage : 8 < 9 
Lightning damage : 8 < 9 
Doubled lightning damage : 16 < 18 

[u]Salvation and Salvation X [/u]
Added new card text : You are granted Regen(1).

[b]Lee the Dragon Master [/b]
[i]Lee’s only interrupt card is on Dragon Pounce, which is a 2 action point card, making it hard to be effective against spells. We’re adding interrupt to one more card in Lee’s arsenal. [/i]

[u]Inch punch and Inch Punch X [/u]
New card text : this attack can interrupt your opponent 

[b]Redeye the werewolf [/b]
[u]Endless hunger and endless hunger x [/u]
[i]We’ve restructured the card text of this card to make it more playable by making the card more powerful at base. [/i]

[u]Endless hunger [/u]
Removed old card text 
New card text : You are granted Feeding(3). If you opponent is Bleeding, Heal 3 lives. 

[u]Endless hunger X[/u] 
Removed old card text 
New card text : You are granted Feeding(3). If you opponent is Bleeding, draw 2 cards.

[u]Scent of Prey X[/u] 
[i]The additional damage from the upgraded card has made this card slightly above the usual balance level for a setup and control card. We’ve decreased the damage so Redeye will have to combo off with other cards such as Howl to boost damage and break defences.[/i] 

Attack Damage : 7 > 6 

[u]Uncontrolled Aggression and Uncontrolled Aggression X[/u]
[i]Although niche, when used properly these cards are extremely powerful and perhaps too punishing to opponent’s that relies on smaller cards to set up. [/i]

[u]Uncontrolled Aggression [/u]
Next Damage Boost : 4 > 3 

[u]Uncontrolled Aggression X[/u] 
Block Value : 5 > 4 
Next Damage Boost : 4 < 5  

[b]Crystal the Ice Faerie[/b]
[u]Shard of Eternity and Shard of Eternity X[/u]
[i]To make this card more flexible, we are decreasing the Mana requirement for a little damage to allow aggressive Crystal playstyles to be able to start doing damage earlier.[/i] 

Mana Requirement : 4 > 3 
Attack Damage : 9 > 8 

[b]Enryu the Gargantusaur[/b]
[u]Feral Defienace and Feral Defiance X [/u]
[i]Feral Defiance is defined by it’s strong defences capabilities but has been often overlooked due to it’s health restriction. This has made it a dead card in many decks when it is drawn early on. We have added in a Level Up mechanic to the card so it can get stronger and stronger when drawn early on, making it almost the ultimate reaction card in the late game. [/i]

Added Level Up Mechanic to both cards 
Block Value at different levels : 6 – 8 – 10 
Added new card text : You are granted Fortify and Persistence. 
Fortify and Persistence Value at different levels : 1 – 2 – 3

[u]Feral Defiance X[/u] 
Remove card text : This card is only playable if you are Enraged or when you have 25 or less health.

notes.title: Death or Glory is launching NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Champions![/b]
Get ready to dive into the epic world of Death or Glory! We at Distilled Gaming are thrilled to unveil the ultimate dueling card experience that’s about to redefine your battles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/7ba7e331d8bf4869ecfa39bc94154357f2aa3a78.png[/img]
Unleash your inner warrior as you face off against formidable Mechs with a flurry of fists, counter magic with relentless bullets, and bring down towering giants with razor-sharp claws! Each champion and class brings unique mechanics and decks tailored to their fighting style, ensuring no two matchups ever feel the same. Every card is an action, and every action demands a counter—stay sharp and adapt to seize victory!

[b]Champions Await![/b]
At launch, you’ll step into the arena with 11 champions from 5 distinct classes. Ten of these champions are returning favorites from our Early Access phase, sporting fresh balances, exciting changes, and brand-new mechanics. But the real star of the show? Ardelean the Vampire! This cunning creature wields blood as his ultimate weapon, empowering his cards with every drop consumed. Unlike other Monsters, Ardelean thrives on strategy, playing a game of wits before striking when least expected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/9287c1b46dc652ff0d53035938c717f7fc602bbe.gif[/img]

[b]Launch Celebration![/b]
To celebrate our epic launch, everyone who jumps into the action during the first week will score a free champion and 20 diamonds to kickstart your arena journey!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/45165a7a88b35c368cfd8c256462e8add8b76683.png[/img]

[b]The Ultimate Dueling Experience![/b]
In Death or Glory, every card represents a powerful action—be it an attack, reaction, spell, missile, or grapple. Control shifts between players, allowing for intense back-and-forth battles where a single turn can turn the tide. With our revamped battle page, featuring a sleek new layout and improved aspect ratios, you’ll experience fluid action and clarity like never before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/e4a9a5c11c7a29fe80f763bceb895b7c71145a7e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/eaf9c383a6f2fe0edfd2e40c3cbd507d9d4d98f9.png[/img]

[b]New Features at Launch![/b]
[b]Leaderboards[/b]: Track your win/loss record and dueling scores for each champion. Get ready for upcoming events and seasons that will refresh and elevate the competitive spirit in the arena!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/c50b841e470d98aafc4eac29190386e6af8dbccb.jpg[/img]
[b]Clans[/b]: From 9/24 to 10/10, join our first Clan Wars! Team up with your favorite creators for exclusive rewards and even a chance to design a unique skin for any champion of your choice!

[b]A New Dawn![/b]
Whether you’ve been with us through the trials of the past year or are just stepping in, this update is a fresh start. We acknowledge our past missteps and thank you for your patience. We’re committed to delivering an extraordinary experience for card game enthusiasts everywhere.

The arena awaits—join us and claim your glory!

notes.title: Team Up, Duel, Win!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Champions [/b]

[i]We are very excited for the launch next week and we want to share with you the cool events that will be happening at launch! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/cb92ff2a01fc16915b851317ccfd72bcbd5a1ed0.png[/img]
[b]Clan Wars[/b]
Team up with your favourite creators by joining their clans to rise to the top. During the [b]24th of September to the 10th of October[/b], every point you score in duelling mode will count to the score of your clan. Bonuses from win streaks and protection from score shields will also be in effect throughout the event. All players will earn an exclusive commemorative card back when they join a clan and the top 3 clans will be gifted a bronze, silver or gold card back respectively. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/c50b841e470d98aafc4eac29190386e6af8dbccb.jpg[/img]

But it doesn’t end there, the winning clan will be choosing their favourite champion to design a new skin and alternate art! We will be working closely with the winning clan leader to bring to life their designs and dreams of what their ideas of a perfect champion is. notes.title: EA 0.2.27 Character Balancing and Performance Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]EA 0.2.28 [/b][/u]

[u][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/u]
 - Performance update improving multiplayer experience and Bug Report Feature
 - Character Balancing

[u][b]Performance Update [/b][/u]
In this patch we have restructured the way multiplayer saves and syncs between one player and another. This should be a positive improvement to the stability of the overall game as we have discovered the previous savings methods was putting a lot of stress on the networking performance. We are still on the lookout for corner bugs such as desync issues, double text and window freezing which we expect to gradually improve as latest updates are live where we have been retooling many parts of the game to decrease VRAM usage. A new feature we have implemented is a Bug Reporting Button that is found in the options menu and surrender pop up. We would like to ask you and our community to help us to better the game and we would be grateful if our community can help our development by pressing the bug report button and writing a small comment when something unusual/unexpected happens. The function of the button is to send us a detailed log of the battle that we could then read and identify the root cause of the bug that was encountered. We are very thankful for our amazing community, and we will continue to improve Death or Glory with everyone’s help! 
 
[u][b]Character Balancing [/b][/u]

[b]Lee the Dragon Master[/b]
[i]Lee as a character has exceeded our expectations repeatedly. With his explosives combos and action regeneration abilities, Lee can reach many heights within just 2 or 3 turns. This is further enhanced by the nature of being a Warrior where, you start and end every turn with roughly the same resources and power level making Lee very consistent playing both the offense and defence. We are making these changes to both reduce the tempo and consistency of Lee between turns so he is more affected by what the opponent does throughout the battle. [/i]

[u]Leg Sweep[/u]
[i]The strong control potential of Knockdown enables Lee to perform OTKs and create huge advantages in one continuous stream of attacks that the opponent cannot react against. With how explosive the control effect already is, the damage boost was making the OTKs even more consistent and often Lee will end up killing without using any “big cards” and just use his regular set ups to do more than enough damage. The damage boost is removed so Lee will have to craft a more detailed hand with specific finishers and resources to OTK his foe. [/i]

Removed Card Text : The damage of your attacks is increased by 1 until the end of the turn. 0

[u]Leg Sweep X[/u]
[i]The upgraded version of Leg Sweep provides a major benefit of 1 extra base damage, which effectively made this card unstoppable through blocks, and your opponent had to rely on much more expensive and specific reactions such as dodge or absorptions. With how fast Lee can be and those types of reactions typically being resource hungry, a knockdown that does 8 damage without much of a cost nor condition has pushed Lee’s deck over the curve more than what we would have liked. [/i]

Attack Damage ; 8 > 7 

[b]Tori the Paladin[/b]
[i]Tori is the stellar embodiment of an Evangelist. Reach transcendence by gaining devotion by playing defensively to set up three powerful turns of transcendence. At that point, an Evangelist is by design blessed by the gods (the game) giving them an unfair advantage of being able to play cards to their heart’s content. This is only balanced by the fact that Evangelists are extremely restricted before they become gods, and it takes multiple turns for them to do so. But Tori’s ramp cards have made her pray with super speed with consistency, allowing her to skip her weak period after the initial turns 1 and 2 in many of her builds. [/i]

[u]Repent[/u]
[i]We decreased the damage of this card to make it more susceptible against Fortify and Windy effects that will now counter this part of Tori’s ramp. [/i]

Attack Damage : 3 > 2 

[u]Sacrifice X [/u]
Removed Card text : Your Devotion is further increased by 1

[u]Reverence X[/u]
Pious Value : 3 > 2

[u]Resolute X[/u]
[i]Managing to land one Resolute X with the additional damage reduction effect effectively meant it was game over, as pretty much none of your opponent’s attacks can go through anymore as everything will be inside of Tori’s blocking range. Despite the cost and setup required for this card to work, we do not think ‘I win’ effects should come from reaction cards. We made a big nerf to the effect right now and looking to find some way to tune it again in later updates. [/i]

Removed Card Text : Reduce your opponent’s attack damage by the value blocked 
Added card Text : Reduce your opponent’s attack damage by 1
 
[b]A.T.A.C.R[/b]
[i]Speed reductions make missiles invincible as they cannot be destroyed unless your attack match speed 3 or above. Although Crippling Volley is not completely dominating the meta, it is a cause for concern for becoming the next ‘can’t touch me’ playstyle for the mech. We are making this card easier to be blocked by reverting the stat buff into the more typical 4 speed stat line.[/i]

Attack Damage : 4 > 3 
Added card text : During this turn, their damage is also reduced by 1. 

[b]Taj the Witch Doctor[/b]
[i]Yes, we’re improving Taj again. But this time is perhaps the last as we feel this is very close to making Taj competitive into the meta. In the initial design phase of the character, we overvalued the worship abilities and thus reduced a lot of the base cards and skeleton of his deck to try and make him counterable. This resulted in making a lot of cards have either lower stats or have delayed effects, and caused the current issues that Taj faces. Compared to many other champions, he is extremely slow and very reliant on his attacks landing in exceedingly early turns which has made him poor competition in the fast meta. Being a mid to late game character, Taj needs access recovery and decent power scaling that can benefit off increased devotion. [/i]

[b]Wall of Carcass X[/b] 
Heal : 3 < Heal(X) where X is the damage blocked
 
[u]Horrid Swarm, Dancing with Ghosts, Jar of Snakes[/u]
Requirement for Damage increase : Transcendence < Devotion value is 6 or above

[u]Crow Avatar X, Phantom Avatar X, Serpent Avatar X[/u]
Card Text Change : Removed all conditions to active keywords

[u]Dark Protection[/u]
[i]We made a big change to how Taj can play by redesigning Dark Protection as a full recovery card that Taj can make use of to recover from big setbacks before his Transcendence. Bigger and bolder plays will allow him to be on the offense more often before he reaches max devotion to start building up his worship abilities. Though this does come with the cost of exhaustion and the requirement of being below certain health levels that is necessary restrict such a powerful effect. [/i]

New Devotion Value : 1 > 0 
New Block Value : 7 < 8
New Speed Value : 3 > 2 
New Card Text : Reset your health to maximum if your health is 15 or below. You become Exhausted. 

[u]Dark Protection X  [/u]
New Devotion Value : 1 > 0 
New Block Value : 7 < 8
New Speed Value : 3 
New Card Text : Reset your health to maximum if your health is 25 or below. You become Exhausted. 

[b]Redeye the Werewolf - Endless Hunger and Endless Hunger X[/b]
[i]We are adding an additional Heal ability to this card so it can serve a wider purpose to a Redeye build that priorities survival.[/i]

New Card Text : Heal(x) lives

[b]Enryu the Gargantusaur - King of the Monsters and King of the Monsters X[/b]
[i]The bloodlust requirement of this card is decreased so it can be more widely used throughout the battle instead of being a dead card. [/i]

Bloodlust Requirement : 4 < 3 
Attack Damage : 8 > 7

notes.title: EA 0.2.26 Mechanic Updates
notes.notes:
[u][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Stealth and Lock-On changes 
[/list]

[u][b]Mechanic Balancing [/b][/u]

[b]Stealth[/b]
[i]Stealth has been a complicated mechanic for a while. On one hand if it fails too often, it does not provide the cost benefit for the caster, whilst on the other hand, the opponent is forced into a roulette where they roll a dice to see if their attacks succeed. We feel further nerfing/changing the percentages will not bring any aid to the problems nor is the mechanic inherently a failed design. We have decided to tackle stealth on two main aspects, its continuation throughout the game, and the methods in which the opponent can interact. 

The first change will be a continuation of the previous balance patch where we will add an additional scenario where stealth will be removed. After the patch, Stealth will be removed if the evasion chance remains at 30% at the end of turn. This will make one application of Stealth at most last for only two turns with it only being at full strength on the turn it is applied. The second change is not directly on the Stealth mechanic but is a change to Interrupt. All attacks that can Interrupt will now always hit a target in Stealth, effectively making the keyword a direct counter to Stealth. The opponent will now have three options to deal with stealth, the first being the most traditional attack till it hits, the second is to stall until it dissipates and the third will be to use Interrupt attacks to break through and combo off. 

Currently, we are making these changes with the notion of them being temporary. Stealth and Susan in general will be reviewed once again after a few weeks of testing and feedback. [/i]

New Keyword Text : Stealth. You have a 60% chance of avoiding active damage. This is dropped to 30% when you attack, counter and at end of turn. Attacks with Interrupt will always hit. Stealth is removed when you take any form of damage and if you end the turn with 30% evasion chance.

[b]Interrupt [/b]
Added ability : This attack will always hit a target in Stealth. 

[b]Lock On [/b]
[i]The highs of Critical hits is certainly one of, if not the highlight of a Sniper’s gameplay. But sometimes when luck (or misfortune) comes too early on, a huge health advantage will be applied completely out of the blue. We are making a change to Lock-Ons mechanics by mitigating the early game potential of it by removing the increased damage at level 1 but instead apply stun to the opponent whenever critical hits. The triple damage will return only when Susan applies multiple levels of Lock On whilst maintaining the stun. Given the huge changes we are making to Susan through the rework of Stealth, we are going for a lighter approach in this first change of Lock On. [/i]

New Keyword Text : Lock on. For each level of Lock on, there is a 20% chance you will take Critical damage after your reaction. At Lock-on level 1, critical attacks will apply Stun and at Lock-on level 2 and above, critical damage will be tripled as well.

[u][b]Character Balancing [/b][/u]

[b]Susan the Sniper[/b]
[u]Mercy Killing and Mercy Killing X[/u]
[i]During Turn 1, most to all champions are at their most vulnerable with minimal resources and a lack of options from the cards in hand. It is very frustrating to be hit with a death mark on an unlucky initial draw, but what is more frustrating is the threat of a second death mark that will come when you show any opening. For certain classes and champions this essentially means, you completely cannot play the game and the game has been lost since turn 1 purely from a bad hand. We are making Mercy Killing a Single Use card and keeping its cost and stats as we felt this will give ample time between death marks for the opponent to ramp up and fight quickly. Of course, Susan can be lucky sometimes and redraw the card in subsequent turns, but that will come down to deck building which we think can create new and interesting dynamics for the character. [/i]

Ammo Cost : 3 > 2 
Added Card Text : This is a Single Use card.

[u][b]Bugs and Fixes [/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Enrage not reducing when damage is partially blocked
[/list]

We want Sora to have the ability to go towards the opposite and have a new fun way of playing the spellslinger class in an aggressive manner with quick and rapid attacks. notes.notes:
[u][b]EA 0.2.20[/b][/u]
[u][b]Patch Highlights [/b][/u]
•	Character Balancing : Redeye defences get dampened and Sora buffs to Ignite and Barrier playstyles

[u][b]Character Balancing [/b][/u]

[b]Sora the Elemental Sorcerer [/b]
[i]This patch mainly focuses on a large revamp to Sora’s overall strength in both setup speed and survivability. Up against aggressive decks, early game Sora barely stands a chance with thin barriers and mana heavy spells that can be easily destroyed by other classes. We are increasing her overall barrier gains and survivability options by giving her access to Double Heal and the capabilities of increasing her Maximum Barrier. We have also decreased the activation cost of several of Ignite cards to push forward her damage potential to start around mid game rather than late game which is more fitting of her fiery passion.[/i]

[u]Astral Rain and Astral Rain X [/u]
[i]We replaced the draw capability of this card with Heal to increase the survivability of Sora in the early game where she will most likely need to lose some health in order to bait out resources for a safe spell casting. Sora already has an extremely potent draw engine in the midgame with Enduring Renewal which counteracts this change and allows both cards to serve different functions. [/i]

Card text removed : Draw a card 
New card text : Heal(4) lives

[u]Fire Bolt and Fire Bolt X[/u]
[i]With the redesign of Tsunami, the practicality of using Fire Bolt is further diminished due to how easy it is to block the card. A small damage buff was implemented to make the attack playstyle more viable. [/i]

Attack damage : 4 < 5 

[u]Water Caress [/u]
[i]Overall we are increasing the barrier values of most enchantments to allow more survivability against aggressive decks by making it easier to sustain a barrier for the end turn added benefits. [/i]

Increased Barrier value : 3 < 5 

[u]Water Caress X [/u]
[i]Double Heal is a new ability Sora gains access with. The previous version of this card really lacked a signature and most of the time it was really not worth an upgrade unless Cure was essential to include. With Double Heal and the new changes to Astral Rain, Sora can come back from the grave every turn and will present a tall hurdle for opponents to answer and climb to victory. [/i]

Increased Barrier Value : 4 < 5 
Added card text : You are granted Double Heal

[u]Raging Inferno and Raging Inferno X[/u]
[i]Ignite often works best when it is applied early repetitively, and the cost made it a completely dead card for most of the game, and by the time you could effectively play Raging Inferno, Internal Combustion could probably do close or more at a higher mana efficiency. We are retuning the stats of both cards to make them viable options to build around. [/i]

New Mana Cost : 4/5 > 2 
New Spell Damage :5/6 > 3 
Raging Inferno New Card Text : Apply Ignite(3) to your opponent. If your Windy is active, apply Ignite(5) instead. 
Raging Inferno X New Card Text : You are granted Windy(1) and apply Ignite(3). If your Windy is active, apply Ignite(6) instead. 

[u]Tsunami and Tsunami X [/u]
[i]To support Sora’s survivability, we have decided to allow Sora to be the first character in game to increase the maximum barrier value. This will allow Sora to gain benefits through Tsunami from the early game and present a different path to support her other effects rather than relying purely on reactions. [/i]

Mana Cost : 5 > 4 
Added card text : Increase your Maximum Barrier value by 1. 

[u]Violent Tornado[/u]
[i]From the playtesting since the release of Sora, we have noticed that Windy has been the weakest part of Sora’s deck. On paper, Windy can be extremely powerful, coupled with Sora being able to increase her attack speed, she can quickly lock opponents out from attacking or blocking. But this has mainly been just a dream, as she wouldn’t have enough time to do all of those things within the multiplayer meta. We are increasing the synergised benefits from Violent Tornado to open up more strategies that can revolve around her wind magic. [/i]

Increased Barrier Value : 2X < 3X 

[u]Violent Tornado X[/u]
Increased Barrier Value : 2X < 3X 
Card text change : Removed Ignite requirement for Ignite(X) 

[u]Favourable Wind[/u]
[i]Sora’s main control package revolves around speed and Windy. Without access to more powerful keywords such as Frozen and Stun, we wanted to expand her buff and debuffing capabilities through stat reduction from this card. [/i]

Added card text : If your Arcane Resonance is 2 or grater, the effect lasts until the end of the game. 

[u]Favorable Wind X[/u]
Added card text : Your opponent’s attack speed is reduced by 1 until the end of turn.
Added card text : If your Arcane Resonance is 2 or grater, the effect lasts until the end of the game. 

[u]Howling Gale [/u]
[i]A small redesign of this card was done to give Sora one more Arcane enabler that would be mana efficient and have subsequent additional Windy effects. [/i]

Mana Cost : 2 > 1 
Windy Value : 2 > 1 
Added card text : Increase your Arcane Resonance by 1. 

[u]Howling Gale X [/u]
[i]In addition, we have added in an Ignite synergy for the upgraded version to allow another way of speeding up Sora’s offensive capabilities. [/i]

Mana Cost : 2 > 1 
Windy Value : 2 > 1 
Added card text : Increase your Arcane Resonance by 1 and double the value of Ignite on your opponent. 

[u]Enduring Renewal [/u]
Increased Barrier value : 5 < 6 

[u]Sudden Squall X [/u]
[i]Sora doesn’t seem to be able to take advantage of Steroid as many of her playstyles doesn’t rely on attacks. We substituted the ability with Windy to better fit her overall playstyle. [/i]

Removed Card Text : Removed Steroid 
Added Card Text : You are granted Windy(1)

[b]Redeye the Werewolf [/b]
[i]The big bad wolf right now is a very strong champion, with huge damage potential and great counters to a lot of other strategies. Monsters are designed to be aggressive and highly dependent on bloodlust which requires damage being done to the opponent through high stat attack cards. This is something we do not want to touch as it is pivotal and key to the monster playstyle. However, monsters on the other hand should not have access to multiple dominating defense cards that can completely prohibit the opposing set up. We are tuning down the defense package of Redeye and maintaining his offensive potential to give a chance to other characters in the meta. [/i]

[u]Ignore Pain [/u]
[i]Cure was removed to give some vulnerability to Redeye from other characters that can be easily countered from Cure. [/i]

Removed Card Text : You are Cured

[u]Ignore Pain X [/u]
[i]We are retaining Cure for Redeye in the form of this upgraded card but at the same time we are reverting the Bloodlust reduction. A 7/3 block that can be played turn 1 and without restriction or setup is too all rounded for an aggressive deck like Redeye. [/i]

Bloodlust requirement : 0 < 1 

[u]Dice and Dice X [/u]
[i]Having access to two Interrupt cards and the ability to Unleash makes playing spells against Redeye almost impossible. We are removing Interrupt from Dice to give spells a chance when Redeye has poor card flow. [/i]

Removed Card Text : This attack can Interrupt spell casting. 

[u]Leap Aside X [/u]
[i]Similar to Ignore Pain X, we are removing the reduction of Bloodlust to balance out the advantageous and weaknesses of Redeye. [/i]

[b]Sora the Elemental Sorcerer[/b]
[i]Sora is the latest champion introduced to Death or Glory. As the fire mage and most offensive spellcaster in the game, she acts as a countermeasure towards defensive heavy and control decks as spells cant be destroyed unless your opponent attacks. However, Sora currently struggles with turn 1 and turn 2 of the game with mediocre but mana heavy blocks, it is often very easy to deny Sora from her set up by just not playing cards. We made adjustments to her early game defensive package to make her mana build more flexible and card efficient so that her mid to late game can realistically happen. [/i]

[u]Tsunami and Tsunami X [/u]
[i]We have redesigned this card to synergise with all other barriers as both an enabler to them and as a defensive tool for Sora in the midgame. This new ability also fits the name and story of the card a bit more. [/i]

[b]Taj the Witch Doctor[/b]
[i]Taj has been a strange one. On one hand, he probably has the most broken set of keywords and mechanics with access to poison, fear, fortify and much more. But on the other hand, Taj probably has the weakest stat lines with many of his defences and worship applications having slightly lower values than the norm. This was done to balance out his snowballing potential, as a fully activated Taj can quickly be unstoppable through just a lucky turn 1. To counteract the various problems Taj may be facing, we have decided to lessen the activation requirements for many of his upgraded worship enablers without touching the stats to leave him still open to certain weaknesses which the opponent can try to combat against. We have also adjusted the time worship and ascended worships stay active, giving Taj a meaningful power boost once he manages to activate his abilities through set-up and careful card ordering. [/i]

The design of A.T.A.C.R was supposed to be surrounding damage boosted multi-hits and explosive missiles, but it is clearly overshadowed by the fun and exciting “Turn 18” gameplan. All jokes aside, this nerf had to happen and I think not much explanation needs to be given. [/i]

notes.title: Control the Elements!
notes.notes:
[b]EA 0.2.16[/b]

[u][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/u]
•	New Champion : Sora the Elemental Sorcerer
•	Double EXP Week! 
•	Card Balancing 
•	Build Up behaviour changes
•	Bug and stability fixes

[u][b]New Champion - Sora the Elemental Sorcerer[/b][/u]
[i]For most practitioners of the arcane art, gaining high proficiency within a magical domain, requires years of dedication. It is therefore unusual for a sorcerer to master a range of elemental skills. Sora has pushed herself harder than most because she is haunted by the last words of her late father. Constantly feeling inadequate and needing to prove herself, she believes her achievements can speak for themselves, not knowing even the most potent magic cannot heal a broken heart.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/2bcf0e45048c54dfb6ded2e0dfe47eddeb77b528.jpg[/img]
[b]Control the Elements! [/b]

The last character to complete the second cycle of releases will be Sora, a spellslinger that is an expert in casting fire and water magic. Usually, one can only be a master of a single type of magic, but through her determination, Sora has mastered both the offensive flames and the protective waters. Use her ignite cards to create huge balls of fire that will cause tremendous amounts of end turn damage that cannot be blocked. Or become inevitable by replenishing and empowering yourself through a reservoir of barriers. Sora has multiple powerful builds that can focus on different mechanics, making every step of her battle, more difficult for the opponent to predict. A deck of potential combos awaits discovery and mastery. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/fe7a0035fe9f3f9442a6488954e28aa9a38ee99e.png[/img]

[i]Sora is now avaliable in Death or Glory! Founder's will automatically unlock Sora upon updating the game.[/i]

[u][b]Double EXP Week! [/b][/u]
To celebrate the release of Sora, double EXP will be available for all characters for a week! Earn, grind and collect cards at a much faster rate to prepare for upcoming tournaments and build your ultimate combo!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/5490f98c4d096f5962b1079e92afebce1224bb5c.png[/img]

[u][b]Character Balancing[/b][/u]
In this update, we have addressed several issues brought up by the community following the last tournament. 

[b]Lee - Hidden Dragon [/b]
[i]Death Mark cards are fun and we want to keep it as a viable build-around for players who like this element of both surprises and telegraphed moves. However, with such a powerful ability, cards that apply Death Mark cannot completely stand on their own to keep the balance. We have received feedback regarding techies feeling helpless against Death Mark as reloading becomes impossible since Hidden Dragon will be played whilst they are immobile. We have decided to reduce the base attack power of Hidden Dragon to a level where Barriers are also countering the card. Additionally, we feel that Death Mark cards should always require some form of setup and pre-requisite that is actively done by the player rather than being based on the opponent having a bad draw of their weaker reactions. [/i]

Attack damage : 5 > 2 

[b]A.T.A.C.R - Repulsion Field X[/b]
[i]To put it short, this card was an oversight that we should’ve picked up on earlier. The ability to apply a forcefield at no cost significantly makes certain classes impossible to set up and makes half of a game’s turn threatless for the A.T.A.C.R. We have added back the heat cost to this card for now, and looking at other directions that can be implemented in the future.[/i] 

Heat Generated : 0 < 5 
Persistence : 3 < 4 
Added Card Text : Draw a card, if your health is 15 or less. 

[b]Taj - Dark Protection and Unholy Refuge and Upgraded Versions[/b]
[i]Taj’s defence package is intentionally designed to be slightly weaker than the average champion as a balancing valve to the powerful worship abilities. Especially with the reactions that can apply worship, Taj would be extremely oppressive if those abilities can be activated at a very consistent rate through reactions. However, because his other reactions all require strict restrictions to play, either through devotion, worship or even health levels, his overall deck is essentially reactionless. In a reaction heavy meta, this puts Taj at a huge disadvantage compared to his fellow champions as he cannot set up and prevent his opponent’s set up. Both our changes to these two cards are designed improve the overall reaction package of Taj by removing their original play restrictions or allow them to function some purposes even at the start of game. [/i]

[u]Dark Protection and Dark Protection X[/u]
Removed restriction : Single-Use 
Added Card Text : When this card is discarded, you are granted Fortify(1). 

[u]Unholy Refuge and Unholy Refuge X[/u]
Block Value : 5 > 3 
Removed restriction : This card can only be played if your devotion is 6 or greater. 
New additional card Text : If your Devotion is 6 or greater, the value of this block is increased by 2. During Transcendence the block value is further increased by 2. 

[b]Susan - Fragmentation Shot and Mercy Killing and Upgraded Versions[/b]
[i]As pointed out from various community members in the discord, Susan’s lack of any short ranged attacks makes Rush and Invisibility cards almost an auto-win against her. We think a sniper should be weak in short range, but to be completely shut out of the game by just including a single card into a deck, is admittedly going a bit too far. We have decided to break the fantasy (slightly) and change two of her cards as short-range attacks. Along with her missiles and defensive abilities, we think she will now at least be able to counterattack to try and win against the unfavourable matchup. [/i]

Attack Range : Long < Short

[b]Crystal - Eternal Goddess and Eternal Goddess X[/b]
[i]Eternal Goddess was designed to be a build around and win condition for Crystal that was an alternate to her signature Freezing. But the low base damage of the card meant it was unreliable and easy to fail due to reactions, and the only way Crystal can set up the card to succeed was through Frozen, thus making the objective fall apart. We have decided to make the attack damage scalable through Arcane Resonance so with the right set up and build, this card can shine and break through without always relying on frozen. [/i]

Attack Damage : X < 2X 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/96eaec0305cc3d8a2f837d3d826163dadb60aca6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/24b7a1f4a651437912d7e64425fa20bde63240d0.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Build-Up[/b][/u]
Thanks to our community, we have been made aware of the incorrect interactions this buff has had in the game. We have decided that build-up should only affect active damaging effects such as attack and counters. Although counters are a reaction, it is an active choice made by the player to do damage with a reaction, thus the effect will trigger. However, things like life loss and end turn damage, should not trigger build up since they are passive and involuntary. If there are any moments that triggers build-up not by actively playing a card, it will be considered a bug, so if we missed any, we appreciate it if you could let us know in bugs and feedback, thank you!

[b]Bugs and Performance improvements[/b]
•	Angry Swipe X behavior fixes  
•	Timers will now only start countdown after your opponent has finished finalising in the end turn phase
•	Fixed various bugs in achievement claiming
•	Fixed a bug in Enryu’s cards that caused crashes and invisible cards to appear during battle

notes.title: The Awakening Raid Event!
notes.notes:
[b]New Game Event : The Awakening Raid [/b]
Challenge the awakened in a brand-new game mode which will test your determination in an all-out Boss Fight between the Living Legend and your champions! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/9a973206833eaead99f15e21b4a1279757970f6a.png[/img]
[b]What is a raid?[/b]
This new game mode will feature an all-new system that expands a single battle into multiple rounds. Raid bosses have extremely high HP and powerful scaling abilities that makes prolonged battles very tough to handle. But you are not alone, the power of one may not be enough but what about the power of 5! Call on the help of other champions to battle the boss by switching into them for the next round. With a combination of big missiles from techies, big spells from spellslingers and gigantic punches from warriors, even the impossible will start to seem possible. 

[b]How to join raids? [/b]
Join raid battles by using event tickets that can be easily earned through playing Dueling mode and completing daily challenges during the event. Entering a raid will cost a certain number of tickets according to the difficulty of the battle. Every damage done to raid bosses will count towards a final score that will be tallied for rewards across the event period. Higher difficulties and defeating raid bosses will award you with additional score multipliers at the end of the battle. Accumulate more raid score to unlock all of the exclusive card backs available during the event, along with new and more interesting awards that will come in future raids. This is our first beta raid event, so we will be carrying over a portion of the score earned into the next raid to award players for joining in and helping us innovate this mode and mechanic further.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/4ceb12b39c24d87ece7d0dd9b96b04bb08858886.png[/img]
[b]The Bosses [/b]
Three bosses have emerged from the shadows of the lost city with an eerie power surrounding them. This phenomenon is known as the Awakening where the inner power of one becomes unleashed, empowering them over time to unimaginable heights. Fight against Test Subject 41507 the Rabid Dog, Dila the Barbarian Axeman and Qian Shou the Living Legend in the ultimate arena. With an enormous pool of HP, the battle will be tough as a bad move may cost you the game if they gain an opportunity to burst you with combos. Additionally, as the battle progresses, a new perk that they gain is the Awakening, which allows them to draw additional cards and start turns with increased action points. There will come a point where the Legend herself will become unstoppable and that is the time to switch into your next champion to continue into the next round where their awakening will be reset and the opportunity for a comeback arises. Take your time to learn your own champion and others that you switch into to find a big combo and win the fight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/6f96b4b156cdf49f43b3f299f662b580bcb98eec.png[/img]
[b]What is next?[/b]
This is Death or Glory’s first Early Access event raid, and we are excited to hear the feedback from players to implement changes and improvements for the next event. We have scheduled more events such as tournaments and other raids into the content schedule for the coming months leading up to Early Access. The introduction of the character switch mechanic is the first step to our upgrade plans to the PVE experience as well as a potentially interesting inclusion into PVP as limited time modes and party rules. Gameplay wise we are in the process of making two additional features in to the raid mode, the fist being deck edits and special PVE specific cards, secondly is a carry on system that brings more elements from previous rounds into the next after a switch to develop cross character synergies that could be exciting. New rewards systems and exclusive items such as special card arts are also in the pipeline for the next events that are also just around the corner. 

[b]New Feature – Battle Tips [/b]
In this update we are also launching a new tips feature that will share with new players what kinds of strategies and gameplay details they should look out for whilst playing different characters. This feature is automatically enabled after the update and can be toggled on and off through the settings menu. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/a4223584f53e6535bc5254d5a7e464089102f157.png[/img]

[b]Character Balancing[/b]
[b]Lee the Dragon Master[/b]
[i]After analysing the deck builds and momentum of his deck, we’ve concluded that he is currently too flexible for the current meta. This originated from several buffs and overhauls we made in previous balance patches where we made the upper and lower combo cards have effects trigger at a much higher rate which essentially made Lee restriction-less with his ability to recover action points. Along with the eye poke and knee kick package which was both a game winner and a set up card 2 in 1, there was really no downside to him when up against most other champions. This patch will see several of Lee’s core package toned down as we think he is heavily limiting a lot of slower decks with just his base cards alone. This may or may not be too heavy coupled with the last update so we may give some strength back to Lee in the future but in a different form that the approach we took with action points and flexibility.[/i]

notes.title: EA 0.2.11 Roxxor enhancements and Upgraded Cards Balancing
notes.notes:
[b]EA 0.2.11[/b]

[b]Patch Highlights [/b]
[list]
[*] Character Balancing - Roxxor playstyle enrichment and problematic upgraded cards balancing 
[/list]
[b]Character Balancing[/b]
[b]Roxxor the Giant [/b]
[i]Designed to be straightforward and simple to pilot, the idea behind Roxxor is to become the stat powerhouse of the game. With many cards in his deck having premium base stats, a simplistic resource system and an overwhelming punch, Roxxor is meant to be opposite of complex deck building like the A.T.A.C.R where a lot of cards are powerful but only when used inconjunction one with one another to create a synergy that makes 1 + 1 become larger than 2.  We want Roxxor to be the counter for the setup decks, with a strong punch, he is less reliant on different mechanics, but is empowered by the mastery of the fundamentals behind attack and defense. However, this tends to lead to repetitive and predictable battles where after a few games and learning his cards, the opponent can quite easily guess the incoming moves and prepare for them. We feel like although Roxxor isn’t necessarily underpowered, the ceiling and potential of Roxxor is limited by his lack of variety and as a card game, will quickly become boring. We are adding in various abilities into his kit that whilst still focuses on the attack/defense trope, adds various new interactions that can make him more interesting to fight against. We are aware that these changes may at first seem to make Roxxor, stat wise a bit more powerful against most other characters, but we are optimistic to see how the format will change and adapt to a new powerhouse in the meta. A close eye will be kept on him to see how everything will settle in the coming weeks. [/i]

[b]Mountain Split [/b]
Added card text : If your Momentum is 5 or greater, attack with Multi-Hit(2).
Damage Stat : 12 > 11
[b]Mountain Split X[/b]
Text Change : Apply Trauma to your opponent. If the effect is already active, attack with Multi-Hit(2). 
Damage Stat : 12 > 11
[b]Danger Brave [/b]
Text Change : If an Attack card is in play, increase the block value of this card by 1 < 2. 
[b]Home Defend [/b]
Removed card text : You are granted Persistence(4)
Added card text : If Persistence is active, your block value is increased by 3. 
[b]Home Defend X [/b]
Removed card text : You are granted Persistence(4)
Added card text : If Persistence is active, your block value is increased by 3. 
[b]Strength Test [/b]
Text Change : Apply Trauma to your opponent. 
Damage stat : 8 > 7 
[b]Strength Test X [/b]
Text change : Apply Trauma to your opponent and you are granted Strength to Strength. 

[b]Upgrade card balancing[/b]
[i]Upgrade cards was first introduced when we launched Adventure Mode, our PVE mode which focused on deck building and working with looted cards to challenge bosses in three maps that get more powerful the deeper you travel. At first, these cards were designed to be tools to match against powerful and at most instances, unfair boss characters that had crazy damage and single cards that wrecks your gameplan if you don’t prepare for them. This was why we introduced various mechanics that triggered on discard, which was a guaranteed benefit for a rare upgraded card slot that wouldnt be rendered useless when up against unfair bosses. This however changes when, PVP is into the equation. We are very happy with how the game has evolved with the introduction of upgraded cards that created many different strategies and deck builds that werent possible with the size of the old card pool. Roxxor the Giant[/b]
[i]Roxxor has been struggling to compete with his fellow champions that have more flexibility and response opportunities. Roxxor is designed to be strong and sturdy but he is currently easily shut down by smaller attacks that bring control or prevent him from playing the two big cards he wants to every turn. We have decided to add Persistence to Roxxor’s kit as a staple to establish a clear identity for the big giant as an unmovable tank. [/i]

[i]This card allowed Tori to ramp without a cost way to effectively and efficiently, making it hard for the opponent to react when Tori has a good starting hand. This change will hopefully making Tori’s ramp more strategically planned and less flexible to be played in any situation. [/i]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE! Dueling Mode and more heads Death or Glory into a new beginning!
notes.notes:
[b]Champions! 
[/b]
The wait is over, we are back and ready to start a new development journey with Death or Glory. During the past 3 months, we have been quietly developing the next iteration of Death or Glory that you will be seeing in this update. Lessons we have learned from launch has fuelled our inspirations towards the progression, the unlocks and the game direction we want to take Death or Glory in the upcoming road to the official launch. Admittedly we are aware of our shortcomings and the disappointment we have left our audience in our initial EA launch. This update is our first step into our response to the feedback and reflection that was left by our amazing community. Once again, we want to thank you all for your patience and support into our project and the game we love. 

[b]Major Directions [/b]
•	Dueling Mode - A fast paced and thrilling arena for a variety of duels and battles
•	Progression - a journey of champions and a challenge worthy of a master 
•	Gameplay - depth and variety from a kaleidoscope of decks
•	Aspect Ratio and UI overhaul 

[b]Dueling Mode [/b]
This new mode will be the new main arena for quick fights in Death or Glory against both AI controlled opponents and other players across the world. Designed to be rapid and ever changing, Dueling Mode is over all quite simple in its structure but deep in how many decks can be built. We are introducing the inclusion of upgraded cards into a multiplayer setting with a twist from adventure mode, you are only allowed to bring 2 upgraded cards into battle. 

Building a Regen deck with Strength X, or focusing on an explosive turn with Equality X will be two completely different takes on the win conditions for Tori. Or how about building a ramp deck for Redeye with Bloodboil X and combo it off with an early Ravenous Chomp X to leech and suck all the life out of your opponent. This is just the tip of the iceberg as to what can be explored with over 180 new cards available in multiplayer. Experiment, discover and most importantly enjoy all the crazy strategies and combos that can be born out of the new dueling experience. But this is not all that is new.

Dueling Mode takes place in the tower of duels, a tower built and erected by great alchemists from a bygone era. Every character will journey through the 8 floors in the tower to reach the top. Accumulate score from each battle won and earn bonuses by maintaining winstreaks to blitz through floors. Every character will start from the Beginner Floors and rank up into Expert and Veteran levels where more cards and different decks can be built. As we continue developing throughout the coming months, we will reveal more about the history and details about this monumental arena as the journey continues. 

Check out the rules and some screenshots of Dueling mode down below! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/ed0c5b1c8bbe15d0b0e1b7f6f247b93f5a3a8505.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/0d8089b4a25870d249b40d4086e99a1b75f05051.png[/img]
[b]Character Progression[/b]
A major focus of this update is an overhaul of each character’s journey in every player hands. We wanted to make every step of the experience with a new character pleasurable, whether it’s when you are new to them, or you struggle through challenging bosses or even when you are dominating game after game, your champion will grow along with your expertise. The new progression track for each champion will introduce 22 more cards to unlock with a variety of fun and interesting targets ranging from just levelling up or playing interesting combos to deal super high damage. Unlock cards, perks, and cosmetics just by dueling and going on adventures. 

The current update will feature integrated progression throughout dueling and the next stage of development will focus on implementing that in adventure mode. Stay tuned for our updates in the second quarter of 2024!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/1de8043318c59b08c24d9d66ddffdc1915866cc0.jpg[/img]
[b]Taj - the Witch Doctor[/b]

[i]Born into servitude and tormented for his smaller stature, Taj sought vengeance when he failed to protect his beloved. Desperate, he bargained with the gods for strength. But their help came at a price. As his power grew, so did his formidable foes. With every step, blood and soul became his currency, paying the toll for his ascent. Taj's journey unfolds amidst sacrifices, as he battles to overcome his past and claim his rightful place.[/i]

Enter the duel as Taj, the next playable Evangelist in Death or Glory. Gain the blessings of the Malevolent Trinity and control the powers of the Spirits, the Serpents, and the Swarm to dominate the arena. With three unique Worship abilities, Taj has very distinct build around cards that can shift his battle style into multiple directions. Control with the Spirit, damage with the Snakes and Swarm with the Crows. The power of the trinity makes Taj nigh unstoppable if he can set up multiple worships in quick succession as he has a strong balance of both control and damage! Explore his decks and expanded possibilities with his upgraded cards in dueling mode today!

*Founders and Early Access Pass owners will automatically unlock Taj, the Witch Doctor as a playable character in both dueling and adventure mode. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/884fefa9eea0c40726f747a0ec9308f24bbfb1fc.jpg[/img]
[b]Game Balancing [/b]

[b]Health and Draw [/b]
A small but impactful change we are making in dueling is the initial draw size and health of every champion. Both players will now start with a Maximum of 40 health and draw 6 cards at the beginning of the game. This was changed after we were play testing and decided that this will benefit will balance both aggressive and late game characters by decreasing the luck of the draw on the first turn. We are eager to explore more deeply into this change will likely make adjustments as the season progresses. Please let us know what you think and how the battles feel after the change. 

[b]Cards [/b]
As we are now opening up Upgraded cards to the multiplayer environment, we have made balance changes to several cards we felt was way too strong and hard to deal with. This round of balancing focused on the clear overperformers and admittedly there could be more subtle combos within the game that we have not discovered yet. We will be balancing the game very frequently moving forward, where we expect to change overperforming and underperforming cards every or other week. Explore discover super combos and have fun!

[b]Doom [/b]
We’ve adjusted Doom to be less frustrating to deal with when it is applied early in the game through the luck of the draw. To balance out the ability we adjusted the countdown value on cards. 
Doom New Ability: A doom counter is reduced by 1 at the end of every turn. When it reaches 0, your opponent will suffer damage equal to their life total, if it is 15 or less. Lower doom value replaces higher one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/4d97f6c884684a3ece174d5f0a2a60e535e8e658.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/c19617e4ec4442d43a1bf7b2af53f27bb7a287a8.jpg[/img]
[b]Future of Death or Glory [/b]

[b]Client Upgrades[/b]
As you can tell from the new client, one huge difference we are making is to shift the aspect ratio of the game into 16:9. Yes, that was a mistake on our part as we started out development for tablets then transitioned into releasing on PC first. In the following months we will be transitioning the rest of the game into 16:9, most notably the Battle Page and Adventure mode. 

[b]Adventure Mode[/b]
Other than client improvements, there will be two big directions where we will be improving. The first being a redesign of Adventure mode, with our new technology and lessons learnt from the 1.0 version, we have been laying the groundworks to create a fun, progressive and at the same time challenging journey for players to go on when they head into PVE. Players can expect to see updates to PVE game modes and content soon around Q2 -3 of this year.

[b]Dueling Mode Enhancements and Content[/b]
We are also aiming to enrich the experience of Dueling mode by adding in different features, card types as well as new champions. There will be a range of content scheduled for the coming months as well as close balancing updates that follows the meta. As an example for what we are eager to implement, is raid battles being part of dueling and events that any player can participate in. 

Our love for game development is going strong. We hope all of you that have been with us since the beginning and those who have just started their journey in the arena will have as much fun as we are in the adventure called Death or Glory. 
[i]
See you in the Arena! [/i]

[b]Enryu, the Gargantusaur [/b]
[i]The Gargantusaur is not a natural species unlike other dinosaurs that roam the land. When the arena started to fall out of favour, the kingpin that owned the business cross-bred enhanced native Tyrannosauruses into an unstoppable titan. Having the current champions fight such a monster would surely make an incredible spectacle, drawing a massive crowd. But can a beast not born of nature be ever contained?[/i]

Dominate the arena as the alpha predator of Corrum! Born as a weapon from a cruel experiment, the Gargantusaur was created as a representation of power. The gigantic monster has scales tough as armour, claws sharp as teeth and the ability to disintegrate anything with a nuclear breath. Join the fight as the King of Monsters and show your foes what it means to be the epitome of evolution! 
*Founders and Early Access Pass owners will automatically unlock Enryu, the Gargantusaur as a playable character in both multiplayer and adventure mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/dd3e45975cc8ffae6b5f55ce89e782e66ae20c8f.png[/img]

[b]Performance Optimisation [/b]
Since our launch in October, the most major complaint regarding the game was the excessive memory usage that clogged the VRAM of most devices causing crashes to the game and on rare occasions the device itself. We apologize for our oversight and any bad experiences we have caused to our players. For the past few months, we have been digging deep into our base code structure and asset management throughout the game to decrease the memory requirement that exceed what would be deemed reasonable. In this patch we want to launch the first large refactoring of our core structure to improve performance. From our studio testing, we have found our new implementations can reduce roughly 45% of VRAM usage for both default and enhanced graphics mode. We are still in the process of replacing some assets that lost some picture quality and pixel density, but we felt we wanted to push this performance change this update as the first step to our battle. We hope any players who have before avoided the enhanced graphics mode or experienced any performance crashes to now have a new experience with Death or Glory. Please let us know your experience after the patch as we continue moving forward with our performance patching and once again thank you for the great support and sticking with us despite our flaws. 
 
A great big thank you from Distilled Gaming.

[b]Balance Change [/b]

[b]Windy[/b]
[i]The design of windy is to create a sense of urgency and inevitability. When windy stacks, less attack options become avaliable for the opposition`. However the current implementation of windy can make the inevitable come within 2 or even 1 turn due to specific card ordering and initial draws. We’ve decided to change windy to only be stackable once per turn to smoothen out the play experience. This will retain the ability to stack more than 1 value of windy per turn but only once, therefore by playing powerful cards Windy can still be gained more rapidly, but not by playing small cards repeatedly in a single turn. [/i]

We nerfed some of her main combo enablers whilst gave a few buffs to some of her hidden gems that might’ve been overshadowed by her other cool cards. [/i]

[i]A card that we’ve always wanted to shine a bit more is Eviscerate X, with its signature high Bleeding output and cool alternate art, it's always a delight to see and admire when it is in hand. Though that's not really the case when we want to be competitive, a 2X bleeding isn’t really too viable against high boss health and the RNG of bleeding. [i]This card has been on our radar for a while due to its interaction with blessing and application of Fortify and Regen that can practically make Tori an unstoppable tank. However facing a turn 1 BFM along with a bad starting hand makes for a very bad day as that battle is almost immediately lost. We decided to rebalance the card to avoid this extreme case whilst giving it slightly more power to compensate. [/i]

[u][b]Balancing [/b][/u]

[b]Lee the Dragon Master [/b]
[i]In the last update we adjusted the reaction cards of the dragon master by reducing the action cost thus levitating the opportunity cost of blocking. This update we will adjust the upper and lower strike package to fit in line with other characters. The problem with the existing mechanics is in order for Lee to activate card texts, his strikes must first be successful AND have a corresponding strike in play first. This results in a large restriction to Lee’s play style as every strike that is played becomes premium. We envisioned Lee to be a flexible jack of all trades warrior that can adapt to situations and pull out the correct tools at the right time. We adjusted a number of his strikes to have an effect on success and be boosted when the upper and lower conditions are met, opening up different patterns of play to make way for the dragon age. [/i]
