notes.title: Interview with the winner of our Name the Beast PvP Tournament
notes.notes:
September 3rd, 2023 was a special day in the history of Death or Glory! An official PvP tournament was held between members of our community. Many had arrived to test the game during our Open Beta Weekend event. The race was on for new players to quickly learn the game at an advanced level in order to compete. The tournament offered cash prizes, along with the honor of naming a powerful upcoming character. Prior to the tournament, the fearsome reptile, who will be released sometime during the Early Access phase, was only known as “The Beast.” 

After a grueling battle, three champions distinguished themselves through exceptional play. Coming in at third place was Agent, a brilliant content creator. A newcomer with the handle Sucrash was second; she worked hard to unlock three characters just moments prior to the start of the tournament! First place was taken by a veteran card game player, Master Tilt. 



Q: Master Tilt, congratulations on your glorious win! Can you please tell us a little about yourself?

A: (I am) a lifelong gamer with a great passion for gaming and game design.


Q: How long have you been playing card games? Do you have a favorite?

A: Magic The Gathering came out during my preteens and I really enjoyed playing primarily that for many years, but I had been into other card games like Speed, Blackjack, Poker, Deuces and Uno since I was much younger.


Q: What is your current impression of Death or Glory?

A: It's a very fun and surprisingly unique fighting card game with a fresh art style.  

One of the most unique features is its core concept: a 1 on 1 duel between two unique characters that represent archetypes across any genre you can think of, each with very distinct themes and mechanics. Unlike many other games in the genre, it feels "fast-paced" in the sense that almost every turn and choice feels tense, engaging and impactful.


Q: Do you have a favorite character in Death or Glory yet?

A: My favourite character at the moment has to be the character I won the tourney with, A.T.A.C.R. They have some really cool and unique resource management mechanics and some massive risk/reward plays and combos that are very satisfying to pull off.  (BFM > D&D. Fight me.)


Q: As someone who grasped the game quite quickly, do you have any tips for new Death or Glory players?

A: Have patience.  

Take time to explore each character through the campaigns thoroughly before picking a main character, playstyle or even trying multiplayer. The single-player modes have a variety of challenges that will help players develop a more well-rounded understanding and strategy for each character and unlock more cards that will assist in creating an effective and customized playstyle.  

It's also important to have patience within the matches themselves, it's usually ok to PASS and take a little damage to build up a combo, wait for defensive measures, or just to avoid having too great a card deficit.


Q: Enryu, the name you picked for the Beast, is a great fit! Can you tell us a little about how you came up with the name?

A: The name Enryu, like the concept of The Beast itself, is inspired by Japanese lore and Kaiju specifically. The name is rooted in Japanese mythology and is common in Japanese pop culture like Anime and Manga. One literal translation being "Flame Dragon", I thought it was appropriate because of the fiery-looking traits The Beast displays as well as to pay homage to the origin of its inspiration.


Q: Last but not least — would you opt to capture Enryu, allowing the mages of Pearly Gates to hone him into a fearsome magical weapon, or release him back into the wilderness, knowing that there is some chance he could still pose a threat?

A: I don't believe beasts of any sort should be caged because of their threat to humans; as this world, this land, this realm, was their domain for an eternity long before our egos were born; and it is in fact humans who have proven themselves the greatest threat to their existence and possibly all of existence itself. May The Beast "Enryu" roam free, because it is we who may one day need them to save us from our own hubris.

Our mystery woman will have to be unlocked via special code, the clues for which will start to appear in Discord on April 14th!

[b]New Mode: Raid![/b]
In the Raid game mode, you will face off against an extremely powerful boss character. Boss characters will have 99 health and a variety of devastating attacks at their disposal. Raid Mode offers incredible rewards for the [u]everyone[/u] in the game if certain milestones are met by the combined efforts of the Death or Glory community. The first opponent for Raid Mode is the merciless Living Legend, Qian Shou, whose deadly ribbons can ensnare, suppress, and cut through even the toughest Champions! However, you are not alone — powerful Ally cards are at your disposal!

[b]New Progression System — Challenger Levels:[/b]
Our initial foray into a progression system, the Challenger Levels bar is displayed on the main menu screen and advanced by simply winning matches, either in Arena or Event modes. Every win progresses the bar by one step, allowing you to claim a reward that’s been reached simply by clicking the corresponding icon. New cards, Perks, and other content can be unlocked through this system.

[b]Visual Enhancements:[/b]
Death or Glory has been updated with many exciting new visual effects, including battle effects, UI improvements, and even unlockable animated cards! Spellslinger, Techie, and Evangelist UIs have been massively overhauled to better reflect their classes.

[b]Perk System:[/b]
Perks are passive modifiers that don’t count as a card in your deck. Instead, they transform a specific character’s play style, opening up a variety of new synergies and strategies! Some of the first perks are now available for testing. New Perks can be unlocked by clearing multiple Arena paths.

[b]New Arena Path: Curses of the Damned![/b]
Lady Black, the Dark Arcanist, has cast her curse upon the battlefield! Empowered by pain and suffering, she manipulates the very souls of the fallen! Will you be able to purge her corruption from the Arena?

[b]A.T.A.C.R. Overhaul:[/b]
A.T.A.C.R. is back from the maintenance bay with improved cards that are even more flavorful and synergetic!

[b]Balance Improvements:[/b]
Many cards in Death or Glory have been fine-tuned over the last few months. Additional details regarding balance changes, including a full list of affected cards, can be found in our Discord.

[b]Bug Fixes and Optimization:[/b]
Death or Glory now runs better than ever before. Additional details regarding specific improvements can be found in our Discord.

Let’s get into the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/3f04e0e6806e0099598d9ee2e29e3ec4100e0043.png[/img]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[list][*] We’ve created a proper tutorial to induct new players both into the game’s systems and story.
[*] We’ve created 3 main levels for all classes to play in addition to 5 for each playable class.
[*] Started pre-production on our Teaser Trailer, the script has been finalized and we are now moving on to asset creation such as sound and graphics.[/list]
[h2]Demo[/h2]
[list][*] The assembly of an updated Demo to show off a vertical slice of Death or Glory’s gameplay.
[*] Internal discussions took place to decide on what we wanted to include in the demo that would best showcase our game’s systems as a dueling card game, along with the flexibility that each Champion allows.
[*] The demo was finalized and launched recently to Steam, itch.io, and Gamejolt.
[*] Prepped stream VODS and gameplay videos to go on the Steam page.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/0fe9f314cdbbf6cf9de55643d8024108ead411e1.png[/img]

[h2]Combat Preview System[/h2]
In the heat of battle, being nimble is crucial! As such, we added a combat preview system. It informs players of the consequences of their decisions with highlighted animations, and hints. Playable cards will now have an active aura surrounding them, and their colors will change depending on the context of the situation. May it be an attack or a reaction, this visual assist will free up more of your strategist neurons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/ae033b15ff5668e803a7cd90217f1fdbf40ff853.png[/img]

[h2]Bonus Cards[/h2]
Looking to spice up your playstyle? Have a taste of the newly added Bonus Cards! You can naturally obtain them through character progression, and they can change up the way a character plays and feels. At times, one Bonus Card can even become the centerpiece of a deck! It may be a single feature, but it provides many more strategy possibilities for you, Champions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/02a6ed146042939e542c6e71b7f064374c082fbb.png[/img]

[h2]Art Assets[/h2]
[list][*] As an essential feature of any card game, we’ve taken great care in creating our TCG art.
[*] Finished all Art Assets for all the cards in the game.
[*] Started working on the graphics for rewards, shops, etc.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/eb708253cab8a74deedb9521c3867c015cde9b17.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/3f04e0e6806e0099598d9ee2e29e3ec4100e0043.png[/img]

That wraps up today’s log, however there is so much more to come in the very near future! To stay in touch with us, make sure you join the Official [url=https://discord.gg/rjKeaTfxcW]Discord[/url]! You can also find us on [url=https://twitter.com/DeathorGlory_]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/deathorglory_game/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/deathorglorygame]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://gamejolt.com/@DeathorGlory]GameJolt[/url]. There will be some super rad stuff happening soon, so be sure to keep an eye out!

Go with honor, Champions!

[b]-Isabela
Death Or Glory Community Management Team[/b]

notes.title: Death Log
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/2d6184a3ac20c853d5d1d42f0ca4818182bc687d.png[/img]

Hello and Welcome Champions!
We have been hard at work in the arena’s behind the scenes to make Death Or Glory the best game that we can make. It has been a long journey up to this point, so we wanted to share what we have been up to so y’all can be up to date on our development!
Without any further wait, let’s get into the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/3f04e0e6806e0099598d9ee2e29e3ec4100e0043.png[/img]

[b]Programming[/b]
[list]
[*] First external programmer hired 
[/list]
We decided that we needed an extra set of hands to help with programming, and work within the Gamemaker engine so we could all optimize our time to the fullest.

[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*] Started a redesign on all player characters
[/list] 
As we were fine tuning our design, and more and more characters have been created, we felt we needed to improve the quality of design for all our player characters. We designed our playable characters and NPCs from the bottom up to better reflect the visual quality we can achieve at this stage of our production. 
[list]
[*] Improved version of UI started
[/list]
One of the things we wanted to pay special attention to was accessibility and user friendliness. We started with something that was somewhat clustered, and in the new version things have been moved around to be more visually appealing and have some space for the player to really immerse themself other than be bombarded with a full screen of chaos.

Where we began:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/878b0ce02875d6728f6896a92ed579cfab03b7cc.jpg[/img]

Where we currently are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/e924a7b0cd9228716a6b7aec6d669ba42a04561e.jpg[/img]


[list]
[*] Animation of UI and other card effects started
[/list] 
We created a list of core and secondary card animations, which we are now working on animating to ensure we have animations for every scenario and action. These animations help our players see visual representations of statuses, and will also allow the characters to feel more genuine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/4d01fada4cb53045ec9cb41d7d64fd44ec08e6d3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Key visual production
[/list] 
We started researching and finalizing the direction of Key Visuals. We Combined the feel of Super Smash Bros and Street Fighter together to create a unique look. The idea was to make this game's visuals have the same “big fight feel” of the aforementioned games while still having its own unique identity.
[b]Music and SFX[/b]
[list]
[*] Started commissioning sound effects and music for the game
[/list]
We realized we needed a unique, catchy, and iconic battle theme. This after all is what sticks in folk’s brains when they think of the game, so getting it right was super important to us. This also meant we needed to find the right person for the job.

We also knew the importance of having SFX in the right places and thought hard on where that would be for our game. Naturally, the answer came pretty easily, but still posed the question of how to do it right. We want our battle scenes to be super immersive to allow players to feel really “there”. The answer for us narrowed down to ensuring all of our card actions have their own super unique sound effect. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575826/3f04e0e6806e0099598d9ee2e29e3ec4100e0043.png[/img]

As we continue to work through development and make this game is something a true champion would be proud to play. We want our community to be a part of that journey. We know the value of community feedback and take all suggestions to heart. You can pass along all of your feedback and thoughts to us through our official [url=https://discord.gg/rjKeaTfxcW]Discord[/url] channel, so please join us on our journey!

To stay in touch with us outside of Discord, you can find us on [url=https://twitter.com/DeathorGlory_]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/deathorglory_game/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/deathorglorygame]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://gamejolt.com/@DeathorGlory]GameJolt[/url]. 
Until we meet again champions! 

[b]-Randall
Death Or Glory Community Management Team[/b]
